findings.finding: Independent visual planning overlapped content review, so the intended concurrent path ran in this production request. This is not a claim of faster end-to-end success.

The initial ordering exercise compares same-denominator fractions. Its reviewer could not supply one directly quoted numeric value per option under the existing ordering contract and returned unsupported. The current evidence-only ordering contract does not adequately cover arithmetic values derived from a taught rule.

The initial parse-failed review fragment repeatedly treated the non-scoring answerIndex placeholder as a concern while also noting agreement between the explanation and the correct answerIndices. This supports possible reviewer confusion, but it is not an independent copy of the final repaired question.

Whether the final q3 explanation actually contains the alleged incompatible text cannot be verified from truncated SDK input/output logs. The final classification alone cannot establish that the question was wrong or that the reviewer was wrong.

No log evidence establishes loss of lesson, scoring or source fields caused by the new lean review projection. A full before/after draft is unavailable, so the read-only diagnosis does not conclusively exclude a regression.

followUpSuggestionsNotImplemented: Retain a bounded, access-controlled diagnostic snapshot of only the rejected question and its relevant lesson/source fields for independent review.
